name: Honey Oat Latte
caffeineNote: Not published by the brand or its retail listings
summary: Single-origin cold brew with oatmilk and coffee-blossom honey from GloryBee, a B-Corp producer in the Pacific Northwest. The coffee is a natural-process Red Catuaí grown by the Veloso family at 1066 m in Cerrado, Minas Gerais. At 7.5 oz it is the smallest can we track, $40 for twelve direct. Joe publishes no nutrition panel.
